answer: The most convincing mechanism is vested payouts released over many epochs. Rewards for work, signed against a network beacon timestamp, vest linearly over 200 epochs. A sybil launching a gale of flash-farm identities forfeits nearly everything when those accounts exit or get slashed, since unvested balances burn. Each fake identity must instead survive months of honest activity plus a saffron-priced collateral deposit scaling with network volume, so cloning never beats contributing.
